exposure: maternal or partner travel history to Zika virus-endemic regions during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 181 children from Wisconsin with a prenatal history of maternal or partner travel to Zika virus-endemic regions during pregnancy, compared to 172 gestational and birth date-matched controls, observed up to 7 years of age.
finding: The study found similar developmental screening outcomes and referral rates between children with prenatal Zika virus exposure history and controls, although cases tended to have more referrals for early intervention (P = 0.059).
